_readme: Defaults for every engine parameter. A user config is merged OVER this file, so you only need to specify what you change. Values come from KNOWLEDGE.md where one is documented; the rest are conservative. Tune on backtests, not on live money.
_indicators: Periods feed indicators.py. Changing these invalidates cached backtest comparisons.
_fortress: Multi-factor confirmation. rsi bounds and adx_min are the tested values from KNOWLEDGE.md section 3.
_momentum: Breakout continuation. Needs a higher volume multiple than fortress — an unconfirmed breakout is usually a fake.
_mean_reversion: VWAP pullback within an intact trend.
_exits: sl_atr_mult sets the stop distance in ATRs; risk_reward sets the target as a multiple of that distance.
_risk: NUANCE #19 and #20. risk_pct is percent of capital lost if the stop fires — not position size.
_session: NUANCE #9, #27, #28. Times are IST, 24h. NSE moved the equity close from 15:30 to 15:15 on 2026-08-03; squareoff and last_entry are set relative to the 15:15 close.
_execution: entry_order_type MARKET avoids unfilled-entry bookkeeping on liquid names.
_regime: Scales position size by market regime (KNOWLEDGE.md section 7).
